description: The app accounts the signed-in user has already connected to viaSocket. Body {} answers rows with auth_id, service_id, service_name and connection_label (a JSON string: parse it before showing it, e.g. the email of the Gmail account). Match service_id to find the auth_id an action or automation needs; if the user has several accounts of one app, ask which. If the app is not there, use create_connection_link.
name: list_connections
